summary: Seeds of Decay pass (issue #453): 133 of 151 cards now wired (108 newly wired this pass, up from 25), 18 stay unwired each with a specific blocker note. Five parallel batches evaluated every card against docs/rules/EMPEROR_EDITION_CORE_RULES.md and the engine as it now stands, union-merged onto one branch. New primitives: standing redirects, a destruction shield spanning an action, timed province-strength effects, assignment/destruction watches, action allowances, a before-Proclaim window and Proclaim locks, permanent keyword removal, an Honor-loss record on a resolved action, a true Exchange of Force/Chi, a per-card auto-negation of movement, an attacking-victory stamp, a target-of-last-resort restriction, a Moshi Ino storm watch through the existing Either/Or, a Loyal-like Clan control refusal, static keyword-rule cards, a general attachment-transfer primitive, additional actions usable in the Action Phase, an any-of keyword search, two new Events Phase decisions, an after-action-Honor-gained trait, an effect-key Focus Effect choice, and a shuffle-vs-additional-actions Either/Or. Lane marked shared, not crossed: the only files outside src/L5R.Core and content/ are the bundled card-art JPEGs each new wave carries into src/L5R.Client/Content/Published (routine for any card-wiring pass -- Tezuka's own commit did the same) and the generated catalogue-art.json/catalogue-art-pack.json republish that pin covers them; no UI/QoL code changed. See docs/decisions/2026-09-23-seeds-of-decay-pass.md for the full record and readings for Mendon to confirm.
validation: tools/check.sh --skip-client: all content, core, AI, server and client-transport checks green (full output recorded). Core L5R.Core.Tests suite: 1141/1141 across every suite. Content Python suite: 134/134 including the catalogue-art coverage test, after republishing the art pack (pinned catalogue-art-pr453-20260923-r1, incremental over catalogue-art-pr268-20260922-r3, 3163 scans).
remaining: 18 Seeds of Decay cards stay unwired, each with a precise blocker note in tools/content/build_card_inventory.py: control transfer of an in-play Personality (3, deliberately unbuilt per docs/decisions/2026-09-12-unique-singular-control-transfer.md), a fixed four-province list (2), a Reaction lockout (1), an Additional Action mid-resolution of the same ability (1), an unenforced per-Tactician cap that needs no card change (1), a dead-pile Battle recruit (1), delayed revival (1), a dual-source search (1), a permanent per-province mark (1), an undefined rulebook term (1), a bounded player-level ability grant (1), and four cards each needing two separate gaps. Readings taken this pass (batch reports) are not yet confirmed by Mendon; see the decision doc's Readings section.
